# Kawaro

> A free, open source file converter for Linux and Windows. Select files, right click, pick a cell in a hexagonal hive; the result is saved next to the original. Everything runs on your machine: no uploads, no telemetry. Version 0.4.2.

- [Quick start](https://kawaro.sbarah.com/en/docs/start.md)
- [Install](https://kawaro.sbarah.com/en/docs/install.md)

## Project

- [Download](https://kawaro.sbarah.com/en/#download): Linux DEB and RPM, Windows MSI; SHA256SUMS steps in the install guide
- [Windows and SmartScreen](https://kawaro.sbarah.com/en/windows/): the Windows build is test-signed with a self-signed certificate, so SmartScreen warns
- [Releases](https://kawaro.sbarah.com/en/releases.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro): GPL-3.0-or-later
